implementation.name: S32 X (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 144 HDL source files (45 systemverilog, 80 verilog, 19 vhdl) alongside 10 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: hand-mapped, not MRA-setname-derived -- a console core ships no MRA files. The core reimplements the Sega 32X on a Mega Drive, giving machine_id 32x. Every id was checked against extract/machine.json. License: the repository has no LICENSE, COPYING or COPYRIGHT file; the grant lives in the source header at https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/S32X_MiSTer/blob/main/S32X.sv, which offers the work under the GNU General Public License "either version 2 of the License, or (at your option) any later version" -- hence GPL-2.0-or-later. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 144 source files (45 systemverilog, 80 verilog, 19 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.
